summary_en: FY11/26 year-end dividend raised to 18¥/share (from 17¥ forecast), lifting full-year payout to 34¥ (interim 16¥ + year-end 18¥, +2¥ vs. prior guidance). Full-year net profit forecast revised up 13.5% to ¥5.9B on stronger Energy & Solutions and Engineering & Maintenance results.
title_en: Notice of Variance between FY11/26 Q2 Interim Forecasted and Actual Consolidated Results, Revisions to Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sala Corporation revised its FY11/26 dividend guidance on 7 July 2026, raising the year-end payout and full-year total. The interim dividend (second quarter) was confirmed at 16¥/share (already paid). The year-end dividend is now forecast at 18¥/share, up 1¥ from the previous 17¥ guidance issued on 13 January 2026. This lifts the full-year dividend to 34¥/share total, an increase of 2¥ compared to the earlier forecast of 32¥.

The revision was driven by upward modifications to full-year earnings expectations. Net profit attributable to parent shareholders is now forecast at ¥5.9 billion (up 13.5% from the prior ¥5.2 billion forecast), and operating profit is raised to ¥7.8 billion (up 4.0%). The second quarter cumulative results (six months ended 31 May 2026) came in ahead of forecast, with operating profit at ¥7.455 billion versus ¥6.0 billion projected, and interim net profit at ¥5.593 billion versus ¥4.1 billion expected. The outperformance in both Energy & Solutions (from strong equipment and construction sales in residential and business segments) and Engineering & Maintenance (from large project completion) drove the upgrades.
